A simple medicine; for so many things. I add hot water and let it soak.
-Uses-
+ Anti Depressant-ish qualities
+ Kinda makes a nice tea; I boil mine with whole seeds! Haven't ran into any problems; I flush the seeds down the toilet too.
+ I sometimes notice it has a neat sleepy effect when I get insomnia
+ It has caused severe but nowhere near concerning (though extremely painful) headaches with food and coffee interactions
It has caused severe but nowhere near concerning (though extremely painful) headaches with food and coffee interactions
; however its only when extreme excess is pushed. I can eat almost all of the foods recommended against combining (well... Just a few basic ones like milk, meat, etc; its more about eating fresh food...) with Syrian Rue and in strict moderations some coffee (I love the interaction between microdosing syrian rue (sipping a small small amount of active tea) and then drinking one entire cup of coffee; causes slight headachey feeling but also a few effects.. I have to be careful.
+ It can cause some crazy effects;
the emotional effects can be in my opinion helpful and harmful in larger doses.
It's a very, very, very, very, very, very potent seed by weight! Small amounts can go a looong way!
